question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**for**" indicates the purpose of something. (के लिए)
 
• Example: He is looking** for** his keys.
 
• In the context, "Residential and commercial buildings use electricity for air-conditioning and lighting and oil and natural gas **for** heating" means that these buildings use oil and natural gas with the purpose of heating.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**for**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Coal and natural gas-fired power plants generate electricity. Oil-based products such as gasoline, diesel fuel, and aviation fuel provide most of the energy used in transportation. The industry also uses fossil fuels to produce power and heat needed by industrial processes. Residential and commercial buildings use electricity for air-conditioning and lighting and oil and natural gas **for**__ heating.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **In (में)**: Indicates the location or position within something.

 
 
• **Example: **The book is in the bag.
 
 
 
• **Of (का)**: Indicates belonging or relating to something.
 
 
• **Example: **The leg of the table is broken.
 
 
 
• **To (तक)**: Used to indicate direction or movement toward a place, thing, or part.
 
 
• **Example: **I am going to the market.
